proof_body:
by
  intro a b h
  have key : ∀ m : ℕ, a (m + 1) = a 1 + ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 m, b k := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega), h (m + 1) (by omega)]
      linarith
  intro n hn
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  simpa using key m
target_source: ∀ (a b : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → b k = a (k + 1) - a k) → ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → a n = a 1 + ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n - 1), b k
